'''1999 Endor Regionals''' was a Decipher-era constructed event. Published lists from this event are the 60s Decipher posted on Deck Designs.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Dates:''' 4 September 1999<ref name="tr-d31" />
* '''Site:''' Embassy Suites, Portland Airport (Portland, Oregon)<ref name="tr-d31" />
